item.title: Crops & Farms 1.5

Live the complete farming dream with our Crops & Farms Add-On! Expand your homestead with NEW farm animals & PETS. Get growing exciting fresh crops, harvest with your tools and craft into your favorite dishes & items.

item.howToTitle: Getting Started with the Crops & Farms Add-On

howToEntries.heading: 1. First Steps
howToEntries.content:
- With the Guidebook and some Paper & Wood, craft Blueprints & a Workbench. Both blocks are needed for further crafting. 
- Next, place the Blueprints on top of the Workbench to turn them into a functional Crafting Station. At the Blueprints, you can find many new crafting recipes. For now, craft a Seed Processor.
- You also need to find & break Grass Blocks to obtain Wild Seeds. These Wild Seeds can be used on the Seed Processor to process them into a random Crops & Farm seed.
- More seeds can be crafted from fully grown Crops.

howToEntries.heading: 2. Crop Types
howToEntries.content:
- Most Crops & Farm crops are placed onto farmland like regular crops.
- Some of them require special Frames that need to be placed onto the Farmland first. These can be crafted at Blueprints.
- Aquatic Crops can only be placed on Flooded Farmland, made by using a Hoe on dirt covered by 1 layer of water.
- Additionally, there are a variety of Fruit Tree Saplings, which grow into Trees. Fruit occasionally grow from their leaves.

howToEntries.heading: 3. Multi-block Workstations
howToEntries.content: - Some devices required for further processing need to be assembled as structures first. The Kiln, Fruit Press the decorative Big Kegs are made by placing 8 base blocks into a 2x2x2 grid.

howToEntries.heading: 4. Farm Animals
howToEntries.content:
- Crops & Farm features new variants of farm animals that have Female & Male counterparts and require both to breed offspring.
- They also follow a sleep schedule and will sleep on special bedding blocks if provided.
- Animals will be happier, generate more produce and grow up faster if they have a Feeder to eat from in the mornings.
